current.text: He is competing for a starting forward spot. The newest preview projects Doncic, Reaves, Grimes, Thybulle and Kessler as starters, with LaRavia as a possible starter instead. Ziaire Williams has also been named as a possible starter.
LeBron James left for the Sixers and Rui Hachimura appears gone, so forward minutes and usage are open on the Lakers.
He should play 20-plus minutes either way. One expert expects the bench forward to still get about 27 minutes, while another compares a starting role to A.C. Green's, at about 20 minutes a night.
ESPN's rank of about 120 is too aggressive. He is a deeper-league or streaming player. He becomes more interesting if he wins a starting spot, and one expert will move off him if he does not start.
The Lakers' rotation choices under J.J. Redick are unclear, and the roster has many players who fit best as 8th to 11th men.
The Lakers play 3-4-3 games in our playoff weeks (March 28 end), which is in the bottom half of the league. They have the second most back-to-backs in the league.

durable.text: He has an odd fantasy game. His shooting percentages swing a lot, and he adds useful steals and assists.
He is a category-only player. Steals are his best category, and he commits few turnovers for his minutes. Points are his weakest category.

note: Yahoo ranks him 164 at a value of 0 USD, outside our 144 drafted players. ESPN ranks him 123 at 1 USD, and the experts call that too high. Do not spend more than 1 USD on him. He is mainly a waiver option. His only real edges are steals (z +1.4) and few turnovers, so he fits builds that chase STL and TO and can absorb low points. Early in the season, check whether he starts over Thybulle and whether he gets close to the 29 minutes ESPN projects. If he does, pick him up.
